description: Low-level memory helpers: pointer operations (bind_local, addr_of, ptr_offset, field_ptr, index_ptr), load/store, volatile byte-exact I/O, ordered atomic operations (Relaxed through SeqCst), allocation (alloc, realloc, free). description: Arena allocator with frame markers. Supports 4 named arenas (MAIN, SHARED, GPU, SCRATCH). Frame-based allocation with alloc_lo (bottom-up) and alloc_hi (top-down). Frame markers via set_marker/release_to_last_marker. 833 CBMC properties proven.

description: Buddy allocator for power-of-two block sizes. Manages free lists per order, supports split/merge of blocks.

name: deferred_free.c

name: ownership.c

name: fixup.c
description: Relocation fixup registry. Tracks allocations by KainRuntimeHandle, registers known pointer references for self-updating relocation, handle-aware reallocation tracking.

name: handle.c

name: bitfield.c

name: union.c

name: async.c
